notes:
Now installs on many more phones.

- Works on Android 8 and newer (it needed Android 11 before)
- Includes 32-bit phones, which many budget phones use
- Smaller download

If you installed 1.2.0, this updates in place from inside the app. If you have 1.0 to 1.1.1, uninstall it first (Android will not update across the signing-key change). Restore anything hidden in the Private album before uninstalling.

On Android 8 to 10 a few things work slightly differently: deleting photos needs the storage permission, and the Private album uses your screen lock or fingerprint.
